description.narrative:
The Project is a priority investment project under the state program on the development of the fuel and energy sector in the Republic of Azerbaijan. It will construct a double-circuit 220 kilovolt (kV) transmission line from Mingechevir hydropower plant to Absheron substation, to replace the existing two single-circuit 220 kV transmission lines (Mingechevir 1 and 2), which have been used for about 60 years. The Project will increase the capacity of the power transmission network in the west-to-east direction. This is crucial for ensuring the required stability of power supply to consumers in the key Azeri industrial and economic hub closest to the capital city of Baku.
The project components comprise (i) construction of a double-circuit 220 kV transmission line of 280 kilometers (km); (ii) construction of Agdash substation with installation of two 125 megavolt-ampere (MVA) transformers and associated 110 kV transmission lines near Agdash substations; (iii) expansion of Absheron substation; (iv) project management support; and (v) institutional strengthening.

Output: Azerenergy operational and management capacities improved. Indicator: At least 30 Azerenergy staff (M/F) are trained by end of 2012. Progress/Status: Azerenerji's corporate team is progressing steadily with the aims of establishing effective management system, improved financial performance, and reinforced staff performance. Data Source: Azerenergy training report Actual value:

Output: New double circuit 220 kV transmission lines constructed. Indicator: 300 km double-circuit 220 kV transmission line from Mingechevir to Absheron to Khurdalan constructed by December 2013. Progress/Status: TL (285 km lines): Out of 907 towers, 788 towers (87%) were erected; 147 km lines equipped with conductors (50%); 103 km of OPGW (35%) have been installed. Absheron-Khurdalan transmission line section already energized without installing OPGW. Conductor spacers for Absheron-Agsu line section already done for 15.5 km. Progress of conductor/OPGW stringing to be improved to ensure that remaining works will be completed by end April 2013. Testing and commissioning expected to be completed by June 2013. Data Source: Azerenergy commissioning certificates Actual value:

Output: Two new 220/110 kV substations constructed. Indicator: Two sets of autotransformers installed in (i) Agdash with a total capacity of 250 MVA, and (ii) Zabrat by December 2013. Progress/Status: (i) Agdash substation: - Control building 92% completed including roof construction; - About 100% of materials for the substation already supplied from Alstom. - Two power transformers installed and ready for commissioning. A Specialist from Turkey (Alstom) arrived to help with the installation of circuit breakers and disconnectors. - 80% of cable trays installed. - All works in the substation (including commissioning) are expected to be completed by end April 2013.
(ii) Zabrat Substation: - 100% of foundations for electrical equipment placed; - 100% of steel structures erected; - 100% of HV equipment installed. - Construction of control building 90% complete; - Control/protection cables connected at the 220 kV protection/control panels inside the control buidling. - Testing and commissioning works of the 220 kV equipment already started. - Control/protection cables connections at the 110 kV switchyard being finalized. - Works related to the 110 kV outgoing feeders to be started soon. - Installing and laying of the 10 kV cables from the Autotransformers to the 10 kV switchgear initiated. - Testing and commissioning still to be initiated.
Data Source: Azerenergy commissioning certificates Actual value:

Output: New double circuit 220 kV transmission lines constructed. Indicator: 97 km double-circuit 220 kV transmission line from Shimal Power Plant to Hovsan, Zabrat, and Sanaye Govshagi constructed by December 2013. Progress/Status: TL (98 km lines): Construction of the overhead line is progressing well. - 321 (90%) of the 356 towers erected; 29 assembled and ready for uplifting; 18 currently being assembled. - 53 km of conductors installed. - Progress with foundation work is 100%. The critical part remains with OPGW stringing and installing of 20 Aircraft warning spheres.
Substations: (i) Zabrat Substation: - Erection of dead-end towers and stringing the conductors to the gantries completed. - Installation of the gantry insulators and connections to the surge arrestors and connections between the 220 kV equipment (surge arrestors, capacitive voltage transformers and disconnect switches) completed. - Control/protection cables already connected at the 220 kV protection/control panels inside the control building. - Testing and commissining works of the 220 kV equipment already started. - Autotransformer cabling works and installation of control cubicles started. Civil works of the transformers oil pit reservoir completed. - 10kV switchgear assembled and placed inside the control building and the control/protection cables completely connected inside the switchgear. - Auxiliary transformers control/protection cables and 10 kV cables already laid inside the cable cellar and in the auxiliary transformer rooms but not yet connected. - Construction of pump house building 85% completed. Substation's wall, outdoor lightings and wall paintings completed while works on the substation main doors still ongoing. - Infrastructure works such as substation streets, gravelling and sidewalks 75% done. Overall estimated percentage of completion is 80%.
(ii) Hovsan and Senaye Qovshagi:
At Hovsan: - Connections between the dead-end towers to the gantries completed. - Control/protection cable inside and outside the control building completed. - Cable trenches and the underground ducts after laying the control/protection cables were closed. - New control/protection panels inside the control building were earthed and connected to the existing earthing grid. - Gravelling of the new switchyard done. - Testing and commissioning of the 220 kV equipment and control/protection equioment works completed. Overall estimated percentage of completion is 95%.
At Sanaye Qovshagi: - Foundations of electric and steel structures for the line feeder 'Zabrat' completed, including erection of the 220 kV steel structures. The 220 kV equipment already placed on the structure. - Connections between the equipment already installed. - Laying/installation of the control/protection cables towards the control building almost completed. However, testing and commissioning have not stated. Data Source: Azerenergy commissioning certificates Actual value:

Progress/Status: - Installation of the 330 kV electrical equipment completed. - 90% of the 220 kV steel structures and 60% of 220 kV electrical equipment erected. - Installatin of the new earthing grid ongoing. - Assembling of transformers finished and ready for testing and commissioning. - Installation of the control/protection cables for the 330 kV and 220 kV have not started.
